title: Red Sox’ Willson Contreras leaves game after scary HBP vs. Dodgers
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox's Willson Contreras was hit in the helmet by a 95 MPH fastball from Dodgers' Will Klein.
Contreras briefly continued playing before being replaced defensively after the third inning.
Contreras leads the Red Sox in multiple hitting categories, including home runs and RBIs, this season.

title: After Patriots coaching stint, DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech staff
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech as assistant wide receivers coach after coaching during Patriots training camp.
Hopkins's role at Georgia Tech reconnects him with offensive coordinator George Godsey and the ACC.
Hopkins, 34, has not formally retired from NFL but shifts focus to coaching at Georgia Tech.

title: Could Efton Chism and Kyle Williams both make the Patriots 53-man roster?
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Wide receivers Efton Chism and Kyle Williams are competing for a spot on the Patriots' 53-man roster.
The Patriots typically carry six receivers, but seven are performing strongly in training camp, creating a roster dilemma.
Coach Mike Vrabel must decide who will make the final roster, especially if Kayshon Boutte remains with the team.

title: Reports: OF George Springer interested in trade to Red Sox, team eyeing INF Xavier Edwards
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: George Springer, 36, is open to a trade to the Boston Red Sox from the Toronto Blue Jays.
The Red Sox are considering acquiring Miami Marlins infielder Xavier Edwards for their infield needs.
Springer has a strong performance history at Fenway Park, despite a down year with a .234 average.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'The Devil Wears Prada 2' featuring Meryl Streep and Anne Hathaway is now streaming on Hulu.
'The Drama', starring Zendaya and Robert Pattinson, is a new dark comedy streaming on HBO Max.
'Furious' Season 1, featuring Emmy Rossum as an FBI agent, is available on Hulu.

title: Here’s how home, away broadcasts reacted to Jarren Duran’s on-field flare-up
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Jarren Duran stirred controversy after a visible on-field incident during the Red Sox's win against the Athletics.
Broadcasters from NESN and WEEI criticized Duran's actions, with some confused and others openly condemning the display.
There's speculation Duran's actions were directed at third base coach Chad Epperson, amid rumors of a possible trade.

title: Drake Maye on building chemistry with A.J. Brown: ‘I am not going to shy away from him.’
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye and A.J. Brown have significantly improved their on-field chemistry during Patriots training camp.
Maye consistently targeted Brown, completing 4 out of 5 passes on Day 5, enhancing the duo's rhythm.
Maye emphasizes consistent communication with Brown, aiming to exploit Brown's playmaking ability throughout camp.

title: Drake Maye, A.J. Brown heat up and other takeaways from Day 6 of Patriots training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Drake Maye went 18-of-19 in team drills since padded practices began Thursday at Patriots training camp.
A.J. Brown showed improvement with several receptions from Maye during 7-on-7 and 11-on-11 drills.
Receiver Romeo Doubs made a standout play in the red zone during a 7-on-7 session at Friday's practice.

title: Massachusetts falls out of top 10 in best state rankings by U.S. News & World Report
author: Annie Jonas
bullets: Massachusetts fell to No. 11 in U.S. News & World Report's 2026 Best States rankings, from No. 9 in 2025.
The state ranked second in healthcare, but fiscal stability and infrastructure ranked 39th and 38th respectively.
Massachusetts performed well in crime and natural environment but dropped to seventh place in education.

title: Massachusetts loses two IHOP restaurants
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: IHOP closed its Cambridge and Hyannis restaurants, leaving about 20 locations open in Massachusetts.
Closures could be due to decreased foot traffic or lapsed leases; both sites were longtime staples.
IHOP is owned by Dine Brands Global, which also operates Applebee's and Fuzzy's Taco Shops.
